PROJECT BRIEF

A shorter, direct link for Kpg. Semalatong

JKR Sarawak intends to take over and upgrade the existing plantation road from Gedong to Kpg. Semalatong, building a shorter, more direct and efficient link between the two.

The new road lets the people of Kpg. Semalatong reach Gedong, Simunjan and Serian towns to market their agricultural produce, and makes it easier to reach government offices.

About 20,017 villagers in the Gedong, Simunjan and Semalatong area will benefit.

20,017

villagers benefit — Gedong, Simunjan & Semalatong area

ROUTE (SCHEMATIC)

Kpg. Semalatong

Gedong

Simunjan · Serian
Pan Borneo Hwy

26 km R3 road

PTSB · QA/QC Monthly Report No. 33 · Gedong – Kpg. Semalatong Road (PWD/HO/B084/2023)

4

PROJECT OBJECTIVES

Why the road is being built

Shorter journeys

Shorten the travel distance from Kpg. Semalatong to the Pan Borneo Highway, Serian Town and Gedong.

Safe, reliable network

Provide a safe and reliable road network system.

Economic uplift

Ease transport of agricultural produce and logistics, raising the economic and social status of the area in support of the government's efforts to eliminate hardcore poverty.

The contractor did not meet the required design strength (40 N/mm²) and target mean strength (47.38 N/mm²) for the G40N concrete grade in the 28-day cube compressive test. The average result was only 38.3 N/mm², with individual values of 34.7, 52.9, and 27.4 N/mm² for the 3 samples. (refer attachment 1.0 & 2.0)

Thus, the contractor must propose and submit a rectification works, endorsed by a Professional Engineer with Practicing Certificates, to the Superintending Officer for review and consideration before proceeding with the next stage of work.

The contractor is reminded to ensure that all concrete materials delivered to the site comply with the construction drawing, contract specifications (JKR/SPJ/2009-S9), and approved design mix.

PROJECT BRIEF

A shorter, direct link for Kpg. Semalatong

JKR Sarawak intends to take over and upgrade the existing plantation road from Gedong to Kpg. Semalatong, building a shorter, more direct and efficient link between the two.

The new road lets the people of Kpg. Semalatong reach Gedong, Simunjan and Serian towns to market their agricultural produce, and makes it easier to reach government offices.

Villagers who benefit
20,017
Gedong, Simunjan & Semalatong area

Objectives

Shorter journeys

Shorten the travel distance from Kpg. Semalatong to the Pan Borneo Highway, Serian Town and Gedong.

Safe, reliable network

Provide a safe and reliable road network system.

Economic uplift

Ease transport of agricultural produce and logistics, raising the economic and social status of the area in support of the government's efforts to eliminate hardcore poverty.

The contractor did not meet the required design strength (40 N/mm²) and target mean strength (47.38 N/mm²) for the G40N concrete grade in the 28-day cube compressive test. The average result was only 38.3 N/mm², with individual values of 34.7, 52.9, and 27.4 N/mm² for the 3 samples. (refer attachment 1.0 & 2.0)

Thus, the contractor must propose and submit a rectification works, endorsed by a Professional Engineer with Practicing Certificates, to the Superintending Officer for review and consideration before proceeding with the next stage of work.

The contractor is reminded to ensure that all concrete materials delivered to the site comply with the construction drawing, contract specifications (JKR/SPJ/2009-S9), and approved design mix.

Corrective action by contractor

Proposal: –

It has come to our attention that earth filling works for the road embankment between CH19+425 and CH19+125 have been carried out without prior approval from Superintending Officer. (refer attachment 1.0)

Kindly take note of the following comments and observations:

1. Submission of locality plan and permit for the borrow pit is still pending.

2. Suitability test results for the borrow pit material have not yet been submitted.

3. Approval Chit for the backfilling activity is pending.

4. Drainage layer provided prior to backfilling is of insufficient width.

Please be reminded that it is the contractor's sole responsibility to ensure that all materials used and works executed are in full compliance with the approved contract specifications and construction drawings. Failure to comply with the above requirements shall be deemed as carrying out unauthorized works. The contractor will bear full responsibility for the consequences of such actions, including but not limited to any liabilities, defects, or claims that may arise.

Implementation of appropriate rectification measures shall be carried out without delay.
